items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: We got Ruth Hernandez. We got (unintelligible) who is a big soprano in Puerto Rico... Then Machito go to the Army... sent to Cuba for Hernandez

ctx.x: I said, great. So I say we're going to divide this in two ways. Let's get a (unintelligible) from Puerto Rico. She's a big star.
Ruth Hernandez. We got (unintelligible) who is a big soprano in Puerto Rico, the outstanding soprano in Puerto Rico. We got (unintelligible) from Cuba.
